chunks: Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Qurashi al-Razzaz narrated to me from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abu Usamah Zayd al-Shahham, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) say: Whoever visits the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) yearning for him, Allah will record him among the secure on the Day of Judgment, and he will be given his book in his right hand, and he will be under the flag of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) until he enters Paradise, and he will make him dwell at his level.
Verily Allah is Mighty and Wise.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the grave of Imam Husayn with yearning?
ai.summary: Recorded in Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, this hadith establishes the theological significance of *ziyarat* as an act of spiritual yearning (*tashawwun*) that secures divine favor. It emphasizes the eschatological promise of being among the *al-mu'minun* (the secure) and receiving one's record in the right hand, culminating in eternal residence under the banner of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.), a motif deeply rooted in Shia eschatology.
